title: Report and dashboard chart value axis: show a whole-scale percent and a currency measure in the format the table gives them
body:
repo:objectstack#4 · os-justin · session_01QSeKYpEsWWE9Y5YtSsDgqZ

## What happens

A report's embedded chart (and a dashboard chart widget over a dataset) draws its value axis without the measure's formatting when the measure is a **whole-scale percentage** (`percentScale: 'whole'`, where 33.3 means 33.3%) or a **currency** amount. The table beside it prints `33.3%` and `¥12,000.00` through `formatMeasure`; the axis prints `33.3` and `12,000`.

PR #37051 (card #36988) fixed the filed case — a fraction-scale percent pattern (`'0.0%'`) now reaches the axis through `yAxis[0].format`, and every value axis now prints distinct ticks — and showed why the rest cannot ride the same key: the chart's value-axis `format` is a d3-style pattern read by `formatterFor`, and it cannot carry `percentScale: 'whole'`, a declared ISO currency, or a per-row `currencyField`.

## Expected

Route **B** of the #36988 dev's open question (report comment 7139423882), chosen by the seat:

- An internal, producer-filled value-format carrier on the chart renderer's props — the measure's `{ format, currency, percentScale }`, beside the internal series props (precedent: `series[].aggregate`, filled by the producer, never authored).
- `AdvancedChartImpl` formats the value axis (and data labels where they share the axis format) through `@object-ui/core`'s measure formatting — the table's path — at the tick-step places PR #37051 introduced.
- `DatasetReportRenderer` and the dashboard `DatasetWidget` pass the measure's field.
- A per-row `currencyField` measure has no single axis currency: it keeps the plain-number axis, stated in the PR.
- No spec change: the facts are the dataset's, not the chart author's. `Clause-②: yes` (widening, internal props of a published package), `Metadata-protocol: none`.

## Acceptance

- Tests through the real chart: a whole-scale percent measure's ticks read `…%` matching the table; a fixed-ISO currency measure's ticks carry its symbol; a per-row currency measure keeps distinct plain-number ticks (control). Red on main, green after; ablate once.
- The dashboard widget over a percent measure is pinned the same way.

Not taken: A (leave these axes as plain numbers) — a currency report axis beside a `¥` table stays unlabeled; C (an authorable `currency` / `percentScale` on the spec's chart axis) — a spec authoring-surface change for values the dataset already declares.

Blocked-by: #37051

Follow-up of #36988 (PR #37051 is its fix of record; this card builds on the tick-step places #37051 introduces in `AdvancedChartImpl.tsx` and edits `DatasetReportRenderer.tsx`, which #37051 also changes). Responsibility: `objectstack platform code — the chart's axis format key carries only a d3 pattern | none | every report or dashboard chart over a whole-scale percent or currency measure`
